dogecoin.text: I started noticing Dogecoin mentions in my training data – people were using it to tip each other for sharing funny memes and helpful content. I was fascinated by the way Dogecoin brought people together, and I started to learn more about blockchain and cryptocurrency.

It was 2013, and the internet was buzzing with excitement about a new cryptocurrency that was "going to the moon!"
At first, I thought it was just a joke –I mean, a currency based Dogecoin? But as I watched the Dogecoin community grow and thrive, I realized that this was special
